summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders, including interim financial statements and MD&A. The report details quarterly results: core earnings of $1.9 billion (up 12% CER), net income of $2.1 billion, core EPS of $1.09, and APE sales up 21%. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. The filing mentions a pending transaction expected to close in Q4 2026 subject to regulatory approvals, but no specifics are provided. No board recommendation, deal terms, or strategic action is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report with no exceptional corporate action.
